role: The Beach (16) and Cold Beach (26) biome class: no passive mobs, sand top and filler, no trees, reeds, cacti or dead bushes.
scope_reason: Overworld biome; all worldgen is vanilla (SPEC Decisions).

members.name: BiomeGenBeach
members.note: decorator counts in deco_of (ids 16, 26); sand top/filler in biomes.h BIOMES; the cleared creature list in spawning.c biome_has_creatures
